system.description: You have a weapon built into your body. Choose one light or medium one-handed weapon, such as a broadsword, baton, or medium pistol. You are trained in this weapon. You can hide or reveal this weapon as an extra action on your turn. If your embedded weapon is a firearm, it reloads through a slot in your arm, can hold ten shots, and fires through a disguised barrel in the center of the palm of your hand. Instead of embedding a weapon, you can embed a multitool that counts as either a set of light tools or a set of heavy tools (your choice when you gain this ability).
